query: SELECT t.root_id,t.state FROM board_threads t JOIN board_messages m ON m.message_id=t.root_id JOIN project_boards b ON b.board_id=m.board_id LEFT JOIN thread_watches w ON w.root_id=t.root_id AND w.reader_key=? WHERE b.project_id=? AND t.root_id>? AND (?=0 OR w.active=1) ORDER BY t.root_id LIMIT ?
